description: Interface definition for UploadedFileInterface in PSR HTTP Message standard, describing methods for handling uploaded files in HTTP requests.

classes.name: UploadedFileInterface
classes.description: Interface representing an uploaded file in an HTTP request, with methods for retrieving stream, moving file, and getting file info.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a StreamInterface instance representing the uploaded file.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a specified location.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file in bytes or null if unknown.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error code associated with the upload.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename sent by the client.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type sent by the client.
